ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 14 Oct 2026: release POLY8 0.3.0.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: 0.2.7 with its runtime package subscribing to ev_play_increment and ev_voice_bind (order 20) and ev_voice_bind_run instead of patching 0x40004100 and 0x40006820; the subscribers are appended under MODWERK_EVENTS and native octabam builds assemble byte-identical. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.2.7 captures are retained. Evidence is emulator-only (synthetic renderer flags and register state); current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds stay waived for this exact version only. Native/browser parity, source-only reproduction and repository checks remain required; the release can only publish once a base built with site events ships. Re-bound on 14 Oct 2026 from ed9b925f3083… to cover evidence/performance.json relabelled to 0.3.0-experimental with every measurement unmeasured (its earlier figures not carried over); the native code is unchanged, and the owner gave the go-ahead to ship the beta without hardware verification.
